# Evaluation source

The `driveaudit_eval/` Python package and `tools/configs/trs_protocol.json` are copied from the AstraDrive/DriveAudit evaluator under the Apache 2.0 license supplied alongside this notice. The release used the `astradrive/code` source snapshot on 23 November 2026. The formal population implementation is `driveaudit_eval/metrics/population_testing.py`. Historical evaluation and research modules retain their upstream names. This copy includes the original CARS attribution source and its notice and license under `driveaudit_eval/vendor/cars/`.

The DriveAudit demonstration adapter lives in `driveaudit/evaluation/`. Source code, protocol constants and license notices can travel with this repository. Checkpoints, runtime environments, predictions and organizer data are provisioned separately.
